remarks: Nestled in the picturesque town of Wilton, CT, this beautifully renovated home offers a perfect blend of modern amenities and charming features. With three to four bedrooms or the option of three bedrooms and a dedicated office, and two full bathrooms, this home is designed for comfort and versatility.  The heart of the home is the fully renovated kitchen, showcasing butcher block and granite countertops, complemented by recessed lighting throughout. The living room is a cozy retreat with a decorative fireplace, ideal for relaxing evenings. The open floor plan provides endless possibilities for entertaining, flowing seamlessly from room to room. Step outside to discover a spacious backyard oasis, featuring a covered deck with a wood-burning fireplace, perfect for year-round outdoor enjoyment. There's also the potential to cultivate your own garden, making it a true outdoor haven. While the driveway is shared, there is ample space for two vehicles. Located just minutes from major roads, this home offers convenient access while allowing you to enjoy the serene Wilton lifestyle.
